text:
maya: heads-up — merged cust-kappa LoRA into staging and the invoice smoketest on int4 is mangling decimal separators for EUR locales (dots -> commas in weird places). attaching minimal output.

tony: yikes, paste a tiny repro snippet please.

maya: run: python eval_pack/run_smoke.py --model kappa-lora-int4 --dataset samples/invoices/eu-locale.jsonl --metrics amount_parse_strict
output snippet:
{"id":"EU-11","pred":"1.234,5","gold":"1.234,50"}
{"id":"EU-12","pred":"12,5","gold":"12,50"}
{"id":"EU-13","pred":"0,00","gold":"0,00"}

alex: interesting that zeros are fine again. looks like trailing zero after comma is dropped or decimal place shifted left one char. fp16 baseline?

maya: fp16 baseline matches gold exactly. int4 only shows these EU-locale decimal truncations.

tony: any tokenizer/normalizer changes in the LoRA?

alex: LoRA should only touch weights. runtime got an experimental decode-fusion for int4 that rewrites comma/dot token merges for speed; might be mis-handling locale adjacent spacing tokens.

maya: ablation plan: (A) int4 forcing standard decode (no fusion), (B) int4 forcing legacy attention kernels, (C) int4 with post-decode normalization enabled.

bench-bot: scheduled job qb-4345678901-eu-decimal-ablation (tags:[cust-kappa,int4-eu-decimal]) ETA 5m

maya: ablation results in brief: (A) standard decode -> fixes predictions (matches gold). (B) legacy attention kernel -> no change. (C) post-decode normalization (pad right to 2 decimals) -> masks the mismatch for matching but doesn't fix model output.

tony: so decode-fusion is the culprit, not attention kernel. likely greedy tie-break/merge ordering around '.' and ',' tokens under quantized logits.

alex: short-term: pin kappa rollout to standard decode on Dedicated and add EU-locale decimal unit in the quick-eval that asserts two decimal places preserved. mid-term: update fused decode to include locale-aware merge rules or run calibrated argmax for punctuation tokens.

ops-bot: canary deploy blocked by policy: "decode-behavior-regression" check failed for repo redwood/cust-kappa -> manual approval required.

maya: opened MR with quick-eval and onboarding note to pin decode: https://git.internal/redwood/cust-kappa/merge-requests/8. assigned to @alex to instrument fused decode and add failing-case logs.

bench-bot: job qb-4345678901-eu-decimal-ablation finished: artifacts at /artifacts/qb-4345678901 (summary: fused-decode reorder causes decimal-drop; standard decode stable).

tony: thanks. alex, can you also run token-level argmax traces for '.' and ',' spans to see how scoring changes between fp16 and int4-fused? that'll guide a deterministic tie-breaker.

alex: on it, expect traces in ~1h.

maya: good catch everyone. adding a playbook entry: "if LoRA onboard shows locale decimal drift on int4, pin standard decode and add EU-decimal unit test until fused-decode patch" :memo:
